lead:
This page documents मेरे planned learning — certifications I haven't yet obtained, tools I haven't yet mastered, और courses I'm currently in progress on. **Nothing here is a current skill or finished item.** This is मेरे honest future agenda.

मेरे overarching career direction is **Computer Networking, Cloud Computing, और Cyberसुरक्षा**, और मेरे certification plan reflects this directly. I've sequenced it: नेटवर्कing fundamentals first (CompTIA Network+, CCNA), then सुरक्षा (Security+, CEH), then cloud (AWS, OCI, Azure).

sections.title: मैं वर्तमान में किस पर काम कर रहा हूँ

content.content:
**CS50 Introduction to Cyberसुरक्षा (Harvard)** — I started this on edX / cs50.harvard.edu. It covers cyberसुरक्षा fundamentals: threats, vulnerabilities, defensive techniques, cryptography basics, web सुरक्षा. स्थिति: started, not yet completed. I still have remaining modules और the final परियोजना to do.

**Vim / Neovim** — Not fully started yet. Learning through vimtutor (built into Vim). Neovim के साथ LazyVim config is already मेरे editor in the [[linux-setup|Omarchy सेटअप]], but deeper proficiency at the keybinding level is still being developed.

content.title: वर्तमान में पढ़ रहे हैं
content.content: Partially reading 'I Came Upon a Lighthouse' by Shantanu Naidu — a personal memoir about an intergenerational friendship और mentorship. Not a business book. About human connection और life lessons. I need to finish the remaining chapters.

content.title: अभी तक कोई उद्योग प्रमाणन प्राप्त नहीं
content.content: As of June 2026, I have no formal industry certifications. The Linux Fundamentals course certificate is a basic course cert. CS50 Cyberसुरक्षा is started but not completed. Everything below is planned के साथ no set timeline.

rows.मुझे यह क्यों चाहिए: Good foundation before Security+. Networking fundamentals.
Gold standard के लिए नेटवर्कing roles in India. High priority के लिए me.
Most recognised first cert in cyberसुरक्षा. I'll do this after Network+.
EC-Council — offensive सुरक्षा focus. After Security+.
Easiest entry into cloud certs — validates cloud fundamentals.
Oracle Cloud — directly relevant given मेरे existing [[homelab|OCI homelab]] सेटअप.
Microsoft Azure entry cert — rounds out multi-cloud exposure.

sections.title: मैं जो उपकरण सीख रहा हूँ

content.content:
**Obsidian (advanced features)** — I currently use Obsidian as a personal wiki host but only scratch the surface. विशेषताs I want to actually learn: Dataview plugin (query notes like a database), Canvas (visual mind maps), graph filters, templates, tag hierarchies, backlink navigation, और core plugin configuration.

**Hermes Agent (Nous Research)** — A self-improving autonomous AI agent (Feb 2026, 123,000+ गिटहब stars, MIT license). Runs across 15+ platforms from a single install. Natural language cron jobs, model-agnostic, closed learning loop, GEPA self-improvement. स्थिति: on hold indefinitely. मेरे current [[homelab|Oracle Cloud VM]] (1 OCPU, 1 GB RAM) is too limited — Hermes needs 24 GB+ RAM. Blocked until the ARM Ampere situation resolves.

I prioritise **CCNA और Security+** as the two highest-value items के लिए मेरे target career in नेटवर्कing और cloud. Both are recognised hiring signals in India — CCNA के लिए नेटवर्क engineering roles और Security+ के लिए सुरक्षा-adjacent roles.

मेरे approach throughout is to build real things alongside studying theory. Each certification target connects to something I've already built: मेरे [[privacy-stack|प्राइवेसी स्टैक]] demonstrates the practical नेटवर्कing knowledge that Network+ covers in theory; मेरे [[homelab|homelab architecture]] demonstrates the cloud concepts that AWS/OCI certs formalise.

No timeline is set के लिए any certification. The honest status is: none started, all planned.
None of these are current skills or finished. These are honest future agenda items.
content.author: Learning Plans document, April 2026
